- Individual name:

- Organization city:
- State/province:
- Country:
- Document date (MM/DD/YYYY):

## A. For each CURRENT or PENDING proposal / active project

- Project title:
- Sponsor/funder:

- Consortium/contractual arrangement or multi-project subproject? If yes, record the overall award number/source but the subproject title, amount, effort, and other details:

- End date as supplied (full date, MM/YYYY, or YYYY; do not invent missing month/day):

## B. For each IN-KIND contribution

- In-kind contribution description:
- Source/provider:

- Broadly available institutional core facility or shared equipment? If yes, exclude from CPOS in-kind:
- Status (`current` or `pending`):
- Estimated US dollar value, rounded to the nearest dollar (must be $5,000 or more; convert foreign currency at submission; estimate if needed):
- Receipt or anticipated receipt date as supplied (full date, MM/YYYY, or YYYY; do not invent missing month/day):
- Associated commitment by labeled calendar year (`YYYY: person-months`; 0–12 per year, up to two decimal places; at least one reported year should be greater than zero):

## C. Foreign appointments / employment / supporting documentation

- Any foreign appointment or employment? (Y/N)
- If yes, organization / country / title:
- Paid or unpaid:
- Start/end dates:
- Time commitment:

- If this is reported in CPOS, separate supporting-document attachment prepared for the relevant eRA module? (Y/N)
- Note if this is a personal service contract or fellow employment contract that may not require supporting documentation:

## D. Exclusions check (so you don't over-report)

- Broadly available institutional core facilities/shared equipment excluded? (Y/N)
- Training awards excluded? (Y/N)
- Prizes and true gifts for which nothing is expected in return excluded? (Y/N)
- Personal/non-research details excluded? (Y/N)

## E. Final admin QC

- Status values only `current` or `pending` for proposal/active project and in-kind entries
- Separate entries prepared for each proposal/active project and each reportable in-kind contribution
- Proposal/project dollar values cover the full project or subproject performance period, include applicable indirect costs, and use the subproject—not overall-project—amount when the consortium/multi-project exception applies
- In-kind dollar values represent the estimated contribution value; all dollar values are rounded to the nearest US dollar, converted at submission when needed, and use a documented estimate when exact values are not readily ascertainable
- XML dates are real calendar dates: use `YYYY-MM-DD` when known, map a supplied `MM/YYYY` value to the first day of that month, and omit a year-only date until the source can be resolved rather than inventing a month or day
- Person-month values are between 0 and 12 with no more than two decimal places; reportable in-kind entries include associated time greater than zero in at least one year
- Overlap statements present (`None` when appropriate)
